info.sub_ename: CIVIL LAW: GENERAL PRINCIPLES OF OBLIGATIONS

description.sub_ename: CIVIL LAW: GENERAL PRINCIPLES OF OBLIGATIONS
description.describe_ch: 介紹民法債篇通則之相關規定內容，內容包括債之發生、債之標的、債之效力、多數債權人與債務人債之移轉、債之消滅，使學生學習理論與實務判例，並有能力去解決有關民法之法律紛爭。
description.describe_eh: The course introduces the doctrines and policies in the general principles of obligation in Civil Law. Topics include the origin of obligation, subject-matter of obligation, effects of obligation, joint creditors and joint debtors, transfer of obligation, and extinction of obligation. The course is designed for students to study theoretical and practical legal thoughts and to resolve relevant legal disputes under Civil Law.

targets.describe_ch: 能用自己的詞彙定義何謂債：能夠描述債發生的原因、效力及其體系的構成；能夠描述債務不履行所規範的模式、種類及其效果
targets.describe_en: Define the obligation with their own words: Be able to describe the cause and effect of obligation, and what the construction of obligation is; be able to describe the model, sort and effect about nonfulfillment of an obligation.

targets.describe_ch: 能瞭解並說明民法債篇的體系及其所要規範的目的。
targets.describe_en: Understand and be able to explain the construction and purposes of obligations in Civil Law.

targets.describe_ch: 能辨識出可適用於民法債篇的案件，並能清楚表達其法律關係。
targets.describe_en: Distinguish and make clear statement where a case can be applied to the Obligations in civil law, and what the law relation is.

targets.describe_ch: 能使用相關法律規定、教科書，完成分析有關債權爭議案件的法律爭點，並由案件中歸納出適當結論
targets.describe_en: Be able to use related legal provision and textbook to finish an analyses about the dispute of obligations, and draw appropriate conclusions from cases.
